cases.brief: Create a Python tracing MCQ with a short sequence of arithmetic assignments and one concrete input. Ask for the return value. Choose distractors linked to plausible order-of-operations or assignment mistakes.

Create a Python tracing MCQ involving a loop, conditional updates and an accumulator. Use a short concrete integer list and ask for the return value. Choose distractors linked to specific plausible tracing mistakes.

Create a Python tracing MCQ with list processing and a helper function. Use several interacting state dependencies that matter to the returned value, while keeping the concrete input small enough for manual tracing. Choose distractors linked to specific plausible tracing mistakes.

policy: One initial generation plus up to three generation/question corrections. Each assessment permits up to three diagnostic error repairs; valid labels are not retried. No reference questions.
